Planned work: Night works between Flinders Street and Burnley

9pm to 4am each night, Monday 5 October to Thursday 8 October  To improve the safety and efficiency of Melbourne’s metropolitan rail network, critical safety works will be undertaken along the Belgrave, Lilydale, Alamein and Glen Waverley lines. These critical safety works form part of Metro’s annual works program to maintain and renew the rail network.  What to expect:  medium to high level construction noise during the set up and use of the heavy machinery rail grinding works that will cause a short-term immediate increase in noise once completed, that will decrease over time increased noise, dust and local traffic in the works area or the rail corridor traffic management in place, as required.  Every effort will be made to carry out these works with respect for our valued neighbours. Works may be subject to change due to weather conditions and operational requirements.

Planned work: Pakenham and Cranbourne services start and end at South Yarra

8.30pm to last service Thursday 8 October To Metro Tunnel All Pakenham & Cranbourne Line trains will end at South Yarra. Take a Frankston Line train to Melbourne Central to transfer to State Library. Take a Frankston or Sandringham Line train to Flinders Street to transfer to Town Hall. To City All Pakenham & Cranbourne Line trains will end at South Yarra. Take a Frankston or Sandringham Line train to the city. From Metro Tunnel All Pakenham & Cranbourne Line trains will start from South Yarra. If at State Library, go to Melbourne Central and take a Frankston Line train to South Yarra. If at Town Hall, go to Flinders Street and take a Frankston or Sandringham Line train to South Yarra. From City All Pakenham & Cranbourne Line trains will start from South Yarra. Take a Frankston or Sandringham Line train and change at South Yarra. Allow extra time to change trains.

Planned work: Trains are back at Boronia Station

First service Tuesday 4 August Trains are back at Boronia Station from Tuesday, 4 August Station entrance is via Erica Avenue. Passengers can access the platforms by using the lift or stairs. A new waiting room and myki facilities are also available at the station. Works will continue in the coming months. The Boronia Station upgrade will be complete in Spring 2026.

Saturday 3 October to late 2026 A section of Albion Station car park is closed due to project works. Access to platforms and drop off and pick up zones remain open during this time. Planned work: Tottenham Station car park

From Wednesday 1 July 2026 As part of Melbourne Airport Rail Stage 1, we’re delivering six kilometres of major rail upgrades from West Footscray to Albion. In order to complete site investigation works, approximately 120 car spaces will be closed in the Tottenham Station temporary carpark. Alternative and accessible car spaces will remain open.

Planned work: Watsonia Station car park changes

From April 2024 to 2028 The Watsonia Station car park has been closed since April 2024. From October 2025, there will be changes for pedestrians, cars, and buses accessing Watsonia Station as part of ongoing works for M80 Ring Road Completion.  new DDA-compliant paths and upgraded crossings to improve safety and accessibility for pedestrians. one-way entrance from Greensborough Highway northbound and a new signalised intersection for exiting vehicles. relocated bus stop and streamlined loop to support service reliability and reduce congestion.  These changes will be in place until a new Watsonia Station car park is built later in the project. We’re planning our work in the station precinct to minimise disruptions.  no changes to the pedestrian overpass or station platform access. maintaining accessible parking and drop-off and pick-up areas near the station entrance. providing more than 500 parking spaces at the nearby Watsonia Station commuter car park.
